beforePause.dialog:
EYES ONLY // VESPER
×
BRING THEM HOME.

The Drowned Relay was built to preserve human memories. Last night, it began broadcasting them as a distress call.

BREACH THE STATION

Use the central yard and its side lanes. Tap MAP for paused facility planning. CLOSE MAP resumes; Pause opens the pause menu. Break sight and relocate quietly: hunters search your last contact, then return. Gunfire carries 24 m, even through cover.

RECOVER THREE CORES

Follow each cyan beacon to its attached waist-high memory console. Step inside the floor ring and hold the left action button for 0.9 seconds. Stay nearby while the memory is recovered. Nearby receiver feedback follows the local console; your map selection and selected route keep their chosen destination. Each recovery escalates the defense response.

BREAK THE COUNTERMEASURE

The station arms its Custodian to keep recovered memories from transmitting. Disable all three coils, then return to extraction. Bring all three memories back along either lit return aisle. Upload advances only while grounded inside the marked uplink deck at the green beacon. Outside pauses briefly; reenter before decay. Face the yard, use the split baffles and watch open flanks. After the Custodian falls, optional one-use suit service behind the west plate grants +40 health and armor to 60: hold the left action button for 2 seconds on the floor, without taking damage.

Red means danger. Cyan means life. Soul Shift is your way through.

ACCEPT BRIEFING
↗

beforePause.dialog:
OPERATOR HANDBOOK
×
SWIPE INSTRUCTIONS ↑
MOVE WITH PURPOSE.
MOVE with the left thumb. Swipe the scene to turn quickly. Tap a visible enemy or coil to center your aim, then hold FIRE. FIRE drags make fine corrections; AIM zooms and steadies them; tap AIM again for the wide view. Empty weapons reload automatically; TOOLS has manual RELOAD. Tap TURN on a warning to face offscreen danger.
Hold the left ROUTE control to travel; keep it held while firing or using AIM to defend. Scene touch gives free look. MOVE, DASH or JUMP takes over. Near a receiver, keep holding to recover; release after SAVED. MAP pauses for planning.
After three memories, destroy the numbered copper coils. Tap a numbered AIM badge or visible coil to center the view, then FIRE. ARMOR means chip damage; cyan OPEN means stronger hits. Move to a clear face.
When the jammer falls, return to the marked uplink deck and survive the upload. DASH helps reposition; JUMP becomes VAULT near low cover.
FULL TACTICAL HANDBOOK
UNDERSTOOD
↗
